user_direction: Approve all four sheets for runtime; mirror corrected SE cells as SW; neutral breathing idle; SE/SW blink every 6-7 idle seconds, with SW blink mirrored from SE; NE/NW only breathe.
mirror_method: Godot Image.flip_x per 418x418 source cell; no frame reordering; SW blink mirrors the complete eye-patched SE neutral frame.

blink.method: Generated head resized with Lanczos to the 250x250 reference crop. Only two eye polygons composited with a 2-pixel feather. Every other neutral pixel retained. SW frame uses exact horizontal mirroring.

registration.method: Integer translation only; no resampling of approved walk keys. Head silhouette centered horizontally; lowest opaque boot pixel aligned at [192,420].
